delete.lead: You can delete your Al-Barq account here directly — no app required, and no support ticket. Read what happens first: your account stops working the moment you confirm, and erasing the data is permanent.

effects.title: What happens when you delete

removed.title: Permanently removed

removed.item2: Your store name, address, and pickup point (merchants)
removed.item3: Your plate number and last recorded location (drivers)
removed.item4: App notifications on every one of your devices — they stop immediately

kept.title: Kept
kept.item1: The record of past orders and their values
kept.note: These records are kept with nothing tying them back to you personally. They belong to the other parties on an order and are needed for accounting and for settling any later dispute.

effects.timeline: Your account stops working the moment you confirm: no sign-in, no notifications, no presence on the platform. Your personal data is then erased permanently once Al-Barq's administration processes the request — and only until that moment can support restore an account deleted by mistake.

requirements.item2: No unpaid attendance fees, if you are a driver.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: This Privacy Policy explains what data the Al-Barq delivery platform ("Al-Barq", "we") collects from users of this website and the merchant and driver apps, how we use and protect it, and who we share it with. Using any of our services means you agree to the practices described here.

accountData.title: Account data
accountData.intro: When you create a merchant or driver account, we collect:
accountData.item1: Your name and phone number — the phone number is your primary sign-in identifier.
accountData.item2: Your email address, if you provide one.
accountData.item3: Your password, stored encrypted so no staff member can ever see it in its original form.
accountData.item4: The governorate your account operates in — used to keep each governorate's orders separate, and not something you can change yourself after registration.

profileData.title: Additional data for merchants and drivers
profileData.item1: For merchants: store name, pickup location on the map, a text address, and business type.
profileData.item2: For drivers: vehicle type and plate number, and your live location while your account is active — used only to match you with the nearest order and to show your position to the merchant during delivery.
profileData.item3: For drivers as well: your daily attendance log and its fee, and your performance stats (deliveries completed, earnings, and ratings).

orderData.title: Order data
orderData.p1: Every delivery order includes the order value, the amount to collect, the payment method (cash on delivery today), the merchant's notes, and a timeline of status changes.
orderData.p2: The merchant enters their customer's details for that order (phone number, delivery address, and location) for one purpose only: letting the driver deliver it. Al-Barq does not create a customer account and does not keep this data for any purpose beyond fulfilling and following up on that order.
orderData.p3: When an order is delivered, the driver may record a proof-of-delivery photo and the recipient's name.

pushTokens.title: Push notifications
pushTokens.p1: To send instant notifications about new orders and status updates, we register your device's push notification identifier (Expo Push Token) and its platform. This identifier does not reveal your identity and is used solely to deliver Al-Barq notifications.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: Our website uses optional analytics cookies solely to measure page performance. They are only enabled after your explicit consent via the banner shown on your first visit, and you can withdraw that consent at any time.

howWeUse.title: How we use your data
howWeUse.item1: Operating your account, sign-in, and identity verification.
howWeUse.item2: Matching delivery orders with the nearest available driver in the same governorate.
howWeUse.item3: Letting the merchant and driver complete a delivery and communicate about it.
howWeUse.item4: Calculating earnings and fees, and building reports for merchants, drivers, and admins.
howWeUse.item5: Sending notifications about orders and your account.
howWeUse.item6: Responding to your questions and providing support.
howWeUse.item7: Improving the service and its security, and detecting misuse.
howWeUse.item8: Complying with any legal or regulatory obligation.

sharing.title: Sharing your data
sharing.p1: Al-Barq does not sell your data to any third party.
sharing.p2: We share the minimum necessary data between the two sides of each order: a driver sees the merchant's and customer's details for the order assigned to them only, and a merchant sees their assigned driver's details (name, phone, vehicle type) once the order is accepted.
sharing.p3: We may share limited data with the technical service providers we rely on to run the platform (such as our notification service and server hosting), bound to using it for no other purpose.
sharing.p4: We may disclose limited data if lawfully required by a competent authority under applicable Iraqi law.

security.title: Data security
security.p1: We protect your data by encrypting passwords, restricting access to sensitive data by each user's role (merchant, driver, admin), and keeping each governorate's data separate within the dispatch system. That said, no system can guarantee absolute, 100% security.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.p1: We keep your account and order data for as long as you use the platform. When you delete your account it stops working immediately, and your personal data — name, phone number, email, photo, and store or vehicle details — is erased permanently once Al-Barq's administration processes the deletion request. What remains afterwards is the order and financial records with nothing tying them back to you personally, to the extent needed for accounting purposes or to resolve a possible dispute over a past order, and to preserve the integrity of other parties' records tied to those same orders.

deletion.title: Deleting your account
deletion.p1: You can delete your account yourself at any time from the account deletion page on this website, or from the "Delete account" section in your app's settings, which takes you there. All you need is your registered phone number and your password; no approval step stands in the way.
deletion.p2: Deletion cannot complete while orders are still in progress on your account, or while attendance fees remain unpaid if you are a driver — both are temporary and clear once the orders finish or the balance is settled. If the page will not work for you for any reason, contact support and we will delete the account once we have verified your identity.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.item1: Access and review your core data through your app.
rights.item2: Request correction of any inaccurate data in your profile.
rights.item3: Delete your account and personal data yourself at any time from the account deletion page, without contacting us.
rights.item4: Withdraw your consent to analytics cookies at any time from the website.

minors.title: Minors
minors.p1: Our services are intended for merchants and drivers who are 18 or older and legally able to enter into binding agreements; we do not knowingly target minors.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes to the service or legal requirements. Any material change will be published on this page along with an updated "last updated" date.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.p1: For any question about your privacy, or to exercise any of the rights above, contact us using the details shown in the site footer.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.p1: Using the Al-Barq website or the merchant and driver apps means you fully accept these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of them, please stop using the service.

serviceDefinition.title: What the service is
serviceDefinition.p1: Al-Barq is a delivery platform connecting merchants who need orders delivered to their customers with independent drivers who carry out those deliveries, through two separate apps and an admin dashboard. Al-Barq is an intermediary that organises the delivery — it is not a party to the commercial contract between a merchant and their customer.

coverageArea.title: Geographic coverage
coverageArea.p1: Al-Barq's service currently covers the Diwaniyah, Najaf and Muthanna governorates only, with further governorates planned over time (see the "Coverage areas" page). A merchant's or driver's account is tied to a single governorate at registration and cannot be changed by the account holder.

eligibility.title: Eligibility to register
eligibility.item1: You must be 18 or older and have the legal capacity to enter into a contract.
eligibility.item2: You must provide accurate, up-to-date information at registration (name, phone number, and business or vehicle details).
eligibility.item3: You must not share your sign-in credentials with anyone else.

merchantObligations.title: Merchant obligations
merchantObligations.item1: Provide accurate order details (order value, pickup address, and product details).
merchantObligations.item2: Enter your customer's details (phone and address) accurately and with their consent to share them with the assigned driver for delivery purposes only.
merchantObligations.item3: Have the order ready and matching what was entered in the system when the driver arrives for pickup.
merchantObligations.item4: Follow the cancellation policy: free before a driver accepts the order, subject to Al-Barq's terms after acceptance.

driverObligations.title: Driver obligations
driverObligations.item1: Register your daily attendance through the admin-run process — this is what unlocks your ability to accept orders.
driverObligations.item2: Meet pickup and delivery times, and contact the merchant or support immediately about any delay or issue.
driverObligations.item3: Maintain professional, safe conduct while driving and while handling orders and customers.
driverObligations.item4: Hand over the full amount collected from the customer (cash on delivery) to the merchant per the agreed process, and accurately record any amount still held with you.
driverObligations.item5: Avoid repeatedly rejecting or abandoning orders without cause, as it affects your rating and account standing.

feesAndPayment.title: Fees & payment
feesAndPayment.p1: A daily attendance-registration fee may apply to drivers, as set by Al-Barq's admin team, and is shown to you when your attendance for that day is registered.
feesAndPayment.p2: Payment between a merchant and their customer currently happens via cash on delivery; Al-Barq does not process any electronic payment or handle payment card data directly.
feesAndPayment.p3: Merchants are responsible for factoring the delivery fee agreed with Al-Barq into the pricing shown to them.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & failed orders
cancellation.p1: A merchant may cancel an order free of charge before it is accepted by any driver. After acceptance, a cancellation or a delivery that cannot be completed (customer unreachable, refused, etc.) is recorded in the system as "failed" with a reason, and may trigger action under Al-Barq's internal policy.

ratingsAndBlocking.title: Ratings & blocking
ratingsAndBlocking.p1: After an order is delivered, the merchant may rate the driver's performance from 1 to 5 stars with an optional comment. Ratings are used to measure service quality and cannot be edited once submitted.
ratingsAndBlocking.p2: A merchant may block a specific driver from receiving their future orders, without affecting that driver's access to other merchants' orders.
ratingsAndBlocking.p3: Al-Barq reserves the right to suspend or disable any account that violates these terms, is misused, or is found by our system administrators to have submitted inaccurate information.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.p1: All trademarks, logos, and website/app content are owned by Al-Barq Delivery Company and may not be copied or reused without prior written permission.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.p1: Al-Barq is an organising platform connecting merchants and drivers, and makes reasonable efforts to ensure delivery quality, but is not responsible for an order's contents or the quality of a product supplied by a merchant, nor for indirect loss arising from a delay or circumstance reasonably beyond its control (such as weather, connectivity outages, or road conditions).

governingLaw.title: Governing law
governingLaw.p1: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Iraq, and the courts of Iraq have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them, unless otherwise agreed.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.p1: Al-Barq may update these terms from time to time; continuing to use the service after a change is published constitutes acceptance of it. We will post the "last updated" date at the top of this page.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.p1: For any question about these terms, contact us using the details shown in the site footer.
